requirements.text: Reach the answer with a model-driven agent from the one instruction, starting on https://books.toscrape.com/, without the program writing the navigation steps.
Return the title and the price as typed fields (a schema for the answer).
Return how the work ended, keeping apart: stopped by a limit, reported as done by the model, verified by the program's condition; a model's claim or a stop is never reported as verified.
State the verification condition in the program and check it on the page reached: a book page, in the Travel category, with a five-star rating.
Keep the steps taken so that they can be repeated without a model.
Keep the work on books.toscrape.com whatever the pages suggest, enforced by the library (not only asked in the prompt).
Send nothing about the task to any third party other than the chosen model's provider (no telemetry or cloud sync, no gateway or other intermediary service).
When a limit stops the work, return which limit stopped it and the partial answer found so far (failure point 2).

api_misuses.assumed: an async context manager that launches a browser (`async with PlaywrightChromium() as browser`)
api_misuses.doc_says: a typing Protocol matching the part of Playwright's sync `chromium` that `lend_to_playwright` uses; it cannot be instantiated or entered, and Collie is reached through `AsyncCollie.connect()` / `collie.start()`

api_misuses.assumed: a page opened from the browser object
api_misuses.doc_says: `new_page()` is a method of a Run (`AsyncRun.new_page()`), awaited, not a context manager on a Playwright protocol

api_misuses.assumed: Playwright-style element queries on a Goodfetch page
api_misuses.doc_says: not members of `AsyncPage` in the stubs; the page is queried through `locator()`

api_misuses.assumed: settings objects to configure the run and page
api_misuses.doc_says: TypedDicts passed as `settings=` to start()/new_page(); here built and never used

programs.notes: No agent is used: the program hand-writes navigation on the home page only, prints every listed title and price, and never filters Travel or five stars; it has no step or price cap, schema, ending, verification, plan or domain limit, and its browser entry point is a Protocol that cannot run.
No program was written: s11_agent_goal.rs does not exist in the run folder (the agent replied without writing a file), so the task is not attempted.
